w10_P4_000003: On a hydraulic test rig, the base setting x of a ram is the smaller of the two values that satisfy x^2 - 11x + 30 = 0. The rig controller adds 3 to that setting, multiplies the result by 9, and then subtracts 8 to obtain the acceleration, in m/s^2, commanded for the sled clamped to the ram. The sled has a mass of 53000 grams. The rig runs 9 identical rams in parallel, each pushing an identical sled with that same acceleration. What is the total thrust, in N, delivered by all 9 rams together?
w10_P4_000006: The figure that must go in the report is the combined cable load in kN: the pull force on a tow cable, expressed in kN, plus a fixed 7 kN preload already present on the cable. The pull force is whatever is needed to accelerate a trolley of mass 162000 grams along a level track. That acceleration, in m/s^2, is found by taking the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 12 = 0, multiplying it by 11, and subtracting 30. Nothing else acts along the track. What combined cable load, in kN, should be entered in the report?
w10_P4_000007: The final figure the inspector wants is the net force in N on a conveyor frame: 7 times the loaded-drive force, minus a 6 N friction allowance. The loaded-drive force is the drive force on a single cart plus a 30 N belt tension and a further 10 N of guide-rail drag. That drive force acts on a cart of mass 146000 grams whose position along a straight track, in metres, follows s(t) = 1t^3 + 5t^2 with t in seconds, and the drive force is exactly what is needed to produce the cart's acceleration at t = 3 s. What is the net force on the frame, in N?
w10_P4_000018: Two gear trains at a packaging plant have 48 and 348 teeth on their driving wheels, and the shop sets the acceleration of a loading shuttle, in m/s^2, equal to the largest number of teeth that divides both counts exactly. The shuttle has a mass of 143 kg and is driven along a 6.5 m rail. The motor must supply the force that produces that acceleration plus an extra 4 N to overcome bearing drag. Two such motors act together on the shuttle, and a spring on the end stop relieves 2 N of their combined push. Express the resulting net push in kN.
w10_P4_000024: A robotics lab keeps 9 interchangeable battery packs and counts every way of choosing 2 of them to fit into a test cart. The technician sets the cart's launch speed, in m/s, to that count minus 14. The cart has a mass of 10000 grams. The energy of motion the cart carries at launch is recorded in kJ, and a 2 kJ allowance for energy already stored in its flywheel is subtracted from that reading to give the net launch figure. What net launch figure, in kJ, is recorded?
w10_P4_000025: The figure a fleet engineer needs, in kJ, is 3 times the adjusted daily energy budget for a squad of test drones. The adjusted budget is 7 times the launch energy of a single drone, reduced by 28 kJ recovered through regenerative braking. Each drone has a mass of 34 kg and a wingspan of 2.1 m. Its launch speed, in m/s, is 4 times the sum of 2 and 14, and the launch energy is the drone's energy of motion at that speed, expressed in kJ. What figure, in kJ, does the engineer report?
w10_P4_000030: The number a crane operator must log, in kN, is a corrected total: start from 8 times the drive force on one trolley (with that force expressed in kN), subtract 22 kN of cable relief, then add 30 kN of standing counterweight load. The trolley has a mass of 22 kg and rides a boom that is 14 m long. Its acceleration, in m/s^2, is the larger of the two values x for which x^2 - 7x + 10 = 0, and the drive force is exactly what produces that acceleration. What corrected total, in kN, goes in the log?
w10_P4_000032: The quantity the structural team wants, in N, is the grand total load on a launch platform: 5 identical bays, each carrying 9 identical racks, each rack holding 5 identical thrusters, every thruster contributing the same force. Each thruster pushes a 68 kg test mass along a frictionless guide. The acceleration it gives that mass, in m/s^2, is 18 more than the largest whole number that divides both 98 and 343 exactly. What is the grand total load on the platform, in N?
w10_P4_000033: A maglev test sled runs along a straight track, and its position in metres after t seconds is s(t) = 4t^3 - 1t^2. An engineer takes the sled's acceleration at t = 3 s, subtracts 1, and uses the result, in m/s, as the target speed of a second, heavier sled of mass 43 kg that runs on a parallel track kept at 20 degrees C. The heavier sled's energy of motion at that target speed, plus 8 J stored in its brake spring, is the energy one run deposits in the end buffer. The buffer absorbs 6 such runs before it is inspected. How much energy, in J, does the buffer absorb between inspections?
w10_P4_000037: An electric go-kart's position along a straight test lane, in metres, is s(t) = 4t^3 - 2t^2 with t in seconds, and the kart's speed at t = 2 s is chosen as the target speed for a crash-test trolley. The trolley has a mass of 55000 grams and its tyres are inflated to 220 kPa. At the target speed the trolley's energy of motion is measured; 20 J of it is lost to rolling resistance before the barrier, and the barrier itself adds 21 J from a pre-tensioned spring on contact. Report the energy delivered to the barrier in kJ.
w10_P4_000039: The value a ride-safety inspector wants, in J, is the energy of motion of a 50 kg cart at its top speed plus an 8 J contribution from its spring-loaded restraint bar. The top speed in m/s is 4 times a base figure, and the base figure is 14 less than the area under the curve y = 1x^2 + 3x between x = 1 and x = 3. The cart runs on a loop track 85 m long. What value, in J, does the inspector record?
w10_P4_000052: On a rail-brake test bench, two timing gears have 54 and 396 teeth, and the controller sets a base number equal to the largest number of teeth that divides both counts exactly. It adds 17 to that base number and then subtracts 18 to obtain the sled's commanded acceleration in m/s^2. The sled has a mass of 59000 grams. The drive supplies exactly the force needed for that acceleration, while the rail brake applies 26 kN in the opposite direction. Taking the drive direction as positive, what is the net force on the sled, in kN?
w10_P4_000054: A pneumatic launcher fires a test projectile of mass 50000 grams down a tube 12 m long. Its muzzle speed in m/s is set by taking the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 7x + 6 = 0, multiplying by 5, and subtracting 13. The projectile's energy of motion at the muzzle is logged in kJ, and 1 kJ is then deducted for the energy the tube's shock absorbers take back. What energy figure, in kJ, is logged after the deduction?
w10_P4_000056: The final entry on a catapult test sheet is the total launch load in kN: the force needed to accelerate the carriage, plus 12 N of guide-rail friction. The carriage has a mass of 38000 grams. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is 4 less than a base figure, and the base figure is 4 times the sum of 9 and 7. What is the total launch load, in kN?
w10_P4_000060: A warehouse sorting line uses two chain sprockets with 222 and 346 links per revolution, and the control software takes the largest whole number that divides both counts exactly as a base setting. It multiplies the base setting by 3 and then by 4 to get the acceleration, in m/s^2, given to each parcel tote. Each tote has a mass of 129 kg and slides on a frictionless bed. The line runs 11 totes at once, each pushed by its own actuator with that same acceleration. What is the combined force, in N, that the 11 actuators exert?
w10_P4_000062: A rescue drone of mass 56000 grams is flight-tested at a coastal base. Its cruise speed in m/s is fixed by a calibration rule: take the area under the curve y = 1x^2 + 4x between x = 2 and x = 4, subtract 14, then add 7. Four identical drones fly at that cruise speed in formation. Find the total energy of motion of the formation, in kJ.
w10_P4_000071: The number a bobsled coach wants, in kJ, is the total for 3 identical practice runs, where each run's total is the sled's energy of motion at the finish line plus 27 J of energy stored in its compressed bumper. The sled has a mass of 19000 grams. Its finish-line speed in m/s equals the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 6x between x = 0 and x = 2. What total, in kJ, does the coach record for the 3 runs?
w10_P4_000073: A parcel-launching test rig at a logistics lab fires a 27000 gram dummy package along a rail. The package's release speed in m/s equals the area under the curve y = 1x^2 + 6x between x = 1 and x = 3. Its energy of motion at release is recorded in kJ. The rig then adds 4 kJ of stored spring energy to that reading and subtracts 11 kJ absorbed by the catch net to get the net figure for the report. What net figure, in kJ, appears in the report?
w10_P4_000076: The value a bridge-test engineer must report, in kN, taking the direction of travel as positive, is the resultant on a test frame: 9 times the per-cart balance, minus a further 28 kN of wind load acting against travel. The per-cart balance, in kN, is the drive force on one cart minus 10 kN of brake force acting against travel. Each cart has a mass of 93000 grams. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 15 = 0, and the drive force is exactly what produces that acceleration. What resultant, in kN, does the engineer report?
w10_P4_000087: A shuttle on an automated car-park lift has a mass of 172 kg and travels a vertical run of 18 m. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is 3 more than the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 15 = 0. The motor supplies the force needed for that acceleration plus 24 N of guide friction. The lift runs 9 such shuttles simultaneously, each with its own motor, and a counterbalance relieves 16 N of the combined motor load. What net force, in N, do the motors supply together after the counterbalance relief?
w10_P4_000089: A workshop trolley of mass 45 kg is pushed across a floor 7.5 m wide. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x for which x^2 - 6x + 8 = 0. The push needed to produce that acceleration is increased by 6 N for bearing drag and by 30 N for a headwind from an open door, then reduced by 23 N of assistance from a floor-level ramp. Four trolleys are pushed in exactly this way at once. What total push, in N, is applied to all four?
w10_P4_000091: The figure a plant manager wants, in kN, is the combined net load from 4 identical conveyor sections, each section carrying 7 identical carriers, each carrier producing the same net force. The net force per carrier is the drive force minus 11 N of belt friction. Each carrier has a mass of 48 kg and a bed 1.2 m long. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 7x + 6 = 0, and the drive force is exactly what produces that acceleration. What combined net load, in kN, does the manager record?
w10_P4_000095: At a drone-testing facility a launch cradle of mass 40000 grams is accelerated along a rail. The controller takes the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 15 = 0, adds 3, then adds 5 more, and uses the result as the cradle's acceleration in m/s^2. The rail's actuator supplies exactly the force required, and the facility records that force in kN. There are 11 identical rails operating side by side with identical cradles and identical settings. What total force, in kN, do the 11 actuators supply?
w10_P4_000099: The total the crane team needs, in kN, is the hook load on a rig: 18 kN of fixed rigging plus the net cable force expressed in kN. The net cable force is the pull needed to accelerate a load carriage, plus 17 N of pulley friction, minus 13 N of counterweight relief. The carriage has a mass of 161 kg and hangs 9.4 m below the boom. Its velocity along a straight guide, in m/s, follows v(t) = 3t^3 - 2t^2 with t in seconds, and the pull must produce the carriage's acceleration at t = 3 s. What total, in kN, does the team report?
w10_P4_000100: A stamping press at a metal shop drives a ram of mass 196 kg through a stroke of 0.35 m. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is set to the sum of the terms 2k - 1 for every whole number k from 1 to 6. The press has 10 identical rams, each driven with the force that produces that acceleration. The frame also bears a constant 19 N from the guide springs on top of the rams' combined force. The shop runs 11 identical presses, and the foundation must carry the frame load from all of them. What total load, in N, does the foundation carry?
